# Research hypothesis and scope
-
Hypothesis under test: for a DECLARED family of future decisions, learning only residual/decision-relevant causal distinctions can have lower representation and interaction complexity than full environment identification or task-by-task relearning, while retaining post-hoc competence on every declared task.
Non-claim: this report cannot by itself show that all reinforcement-learning methods are inferior. Modern reward-free, model-based, representation-aware, and task-family-aware RL can exploit related structure. Stage 1 optimizes fixed-confidence learn-then-deploy competence, not cumulative online regret.

# 1. Finite theorem-matching controller identification
-
This is the Level-0 gate. Fixed-allocation Stage 1A uses the Hellinger theorem with ceil(n*q_e) integer rounding so every experiment count satisfies the proof condition. Stage 1B rows are heuristic/adaptive and are not treated as theorem-certified.
